headline: An unknown threat actor chained the PHP2Shell flaws and a fresh Gaia OS privilege-escalation bug to take root on Check Point Security Gateways, plant the TSGA backdoor, and wipe ESXi files at Israeli organizations.

emerging_trends.text: The security appliance at the network edge keeps serving as the front door, with Check Point gateways, N-able N-central servers, and Citrix NetScaler all drawing exploit code faster than customers install hotfixes.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Check Point Gateways Fall to PHP2Shell and a Gaia OS Bug

emerging_trends.topic_title: OpenAI Puts Agents on Both Sides of the Pentest

emerging_trends.text: European police have shifted from seizing servers to arresting people, and Operation TorNado shows how long a dark web buyer stays exposed after the marketplace goes dark.

topics.title: Check Point Gateways Fall to PHP2Shell and a Gaia OS Bug
topics.latest_developments: Check Point shipped emergency hotfixes on November 13, 2026 for a high-severity flaw attackers have exploited since late October to take root and hold persistence, and the company detailed a campaign that started October 30, 2026 against Israeli organizations: an unidentified actor entered unpatched Security Gateways through the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, escalated to root with CVE-2026-123039, a previously unreported local privilege escalation in Gaia OS, installed a backdoor named TSGA, and deleted files on connected VMware ESXi hosts, with a wider wave following.
topics.summary: Check Point Security Gateways sit at the perimeter of enterprise networks and route all traffic through Gaia OS. Administrators should install the hotfixes immediately, hunt for TSGA, and check ESXi datastores for deleted files.

sources.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access

topics.title: Operation TorNado Arrests 354 Dark Web Traders
topics.latest_developments: Europol and police in 14 countries arrested 354 dark web vendors and buyers in Operation TorNado, which ran from May 2025 to October 2026 and worked backward from five marketplaces already taken offline—Archetyp, Bohemia, Nemesis, Kingdom, and Tor2Door—as well as forums and single-vendor shops; separately, investigators put this week's Operation Endgame round at 235 servers and 257 domains seized behind Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC, with 6.4 million stolen logins recovered from more than 40,000 victims, according to Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office.
topics.summary: Both operations show that a marketplace or botnet takedown leaves a usable evidence trail against the people who traded on it. Organizations should assume credentials harvested by StealC and Gootloader circulate now and force resets on accounts appearing in the recovered sets.

sources.title: 354 dark web vendors and buyers arrested in Operation TorNado
Police arrest 354 suspects in dark web cybercrime crackdown

topics.title: North Korea Runs Fake Zoom Calls and Fake Engineers
topics.latest_developments: The FBI put the FaceStealer scheme at more than $400 million in cryptocurrency stolen over 18 months, said it has seized more than 900 webcam recordings the operators replay to make fake Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls look real, and warned cryptocurrency and web3 employees plus open-source maintainers on November 12, 2026; Material Security reported the same week that it tracked 27 fabricated North Korean job-seeker personas through the hiring pipelines of organizations it monitors all the way to onboarding over one year, and that one company a persona reached in the past month kept roughly 277,000 files holding Social Security numbers shared company-wide or by public link.
topics.summary: North Korean operators infect a target during a video call that shows stolen footage of earlier victims, then drain wallets, and they also apply for remote engineering jobs under invented identities. Companies hiring remote engineers should verify identity documents against live video and lock down company-wide file sharing before onboarding anyone.

sources.title: Stolen webcam clips of 900+ victims feed North Korea's $400 million fake Zoom scheme

topics.title: OpenAI Puts Agents on Both Sides of the Pentest
topics.latest_developments: OpenAI introduced Daybreak on November 13, 2026, splitting it into Daybreak Red Team, an early-access service whose coordinated agents test web applications and verify the fixes, and Defense Factory, which investigates security findings and prepares patches; the launch lands days after defenders began publishing countermeasures for ARTEX and AntiFox, the agentic penetration-testing frameworks criminals already run against financial firms and cloud accounts.
topics.summary: OpenAI now sells the same agent-driven offensive testing that attackers assembled from open-source frameworks over the past three months. Security teams evaluating Daybreak should also write detection rules for agent-speed credential attacks and cloud enumeration, since both sides use the same playbook.

sources.title: OpenAI's Daybreak brings AI agents to security testing and vulnerability fixes
OpenAI Unveils Daybreak Red Team, Defense Factory Security Tools
Cyber Experts Weigh In: How to Fight Artex & AntiFox

topics.title: ClickFix Lures Wear Zillow, Teams, and AI Brands
topics.latest_developments: EfficientIP Research Labs traced a ClickFix campaign that dressed its pages as Zillow apartment reviews, copied a PowerShell command to the visitor's clipboard behind a routine-looking verification check, and installed NetSupport RAT on Windows machines with its window hidden and a restart at every login; the browser security company Island counted 186 lookalike domains impersonating AI tools, a pattern it calls TypoPrompting, that serve the same verification lures along with browser-hijacking malware and search-hijacking extensions; and Huntress documented attackers who used a fake Microsoft Teams meeting scheduler to talk an employee at a construction company into typing a device code into Microsoft's genuine sign-in page, which handed them a valid session token before the Huntress security operations center caught it.
topics.summary: All three campaigns ask the victim to perform one normal-looking step—paste a command, enter a code—and that step delivers remote access or a session token. Blocking clipboard-to-PowerShell execution, disabling the device code sign-in flow where business needs allow, and filtering lookalike AI domains cut off the common path.

sources.title: Fake Zillow pages use ClickFix NetSupport RAT to target apartment hunters
186 Fake AI Domains Redirect Users to ClickFix Lures, Browser Malware, and Search Hijackers

topics.title: SilentAir Intercepts SMS Codes Inside Asian Carriers
topics.latest_developments: Enea, the Stockholm telecommunications and cybersecurity software company, named a new espionage group SilentAir this week, reporting that it operates hacked equipment inside Asian mobile operators to intercept the calls and text messages of selected people, most of them in Taiwan, and that its attack sources trace to at least six Asian countries; Enea assesses with high confidence that a state runs it.
topics.summary: SilentAir reads traffic from inside carrier networks, which hands it the one-time codes that SMS two-factor authentication delivers. Any organization protecting accounts with text-message codes should move high-value users to hardware keys or app-based authentication.

sources.title: SilentAir Hijacks Asian Telecom Networks to Intercept SMS 2FA Codes and Spy on Taiwanese Users

business_politics.title: Treasuries Head for Their Worst Week Since Liberation Day
business_politics.latest_developments: The Financial Times reported Friday, November 13, that United States Treasuries are closing their worst week since President Trump's "liberation day" tariff announcement, the WSJ dollar basket hit a 19-month high, and bitcoin broke below $70,000 for the first time since August.
business_politics.summary: Hotter-than-expected inflation and hawkish talk from Federal Reserve officials have reversed the bet that the global bond rout had ended, pushing longer-dated Treasury yields up before next week's United States inflation reports and lifting the dollar on expectations of further rate increases. Bitcoin is on course for a sixth straight weekly loss as the tech selloff and higher rates drain risk appetite, and stock futures fell Friday morning with the Nvidia leadership change still hanging over the market.

business_politics.title: A Microsoft Outage Takes Down Outlook and Teams Worldwide
business_politics.latest_developments: Microsoft raced Friday morning, November 13, to restore Outlook, Teams, and other services after an outage hit companies and governments around the world, and the company said no malicious or cyber activity caused it.
business_politics.summary: The failure knocked out the software that large organizations run their daily operations on, including email, messaging, and the Copilot assistant, and it reached customers across continents. Microsoft's own explanation points at an internal fault rather than an attack, which puts the concentration risk of a single cloud and productivity vendor back in front of every operations and continuity desk.

FirstFT: Microsoft races to restore software services

business_politics.title: Chinese AI Shares Slide as Kress Takes Over Nvidia
business_politics.latest_developments: Chinese artificial-intelligence stocks extended their selloff Friday, November 13, on fears that Washington will tighten chip export restrictions now that Jensen Huang, who argued for keeping sales to China open, has left Nvidia.
business_politics.summary: Nvidia's board pushed out Huang this week after 33 years and installed finance chief Colette Kress, whom Huang once called "a deer in the headlights," at the head of the world's most valuable company. Two events next week will test how much of the artificial-intelligence trade rests on him: Nvidia's quarterly earnings and Anthropic's initial public offering.

business_politics.title: The Oil Market Swings Back to Surplus
business_politics.latest_developments: The International Energy Agency said Friday, November 13, that the global oil market returns to surplus in the fourth quarter for the first time since the Iran war began, as Gulf shipments rebound.
business_politics.summary: The agency's analysts warn that rebuilding the commercial stockpiles the conflict drained will take months, which leaves prices exposed to any fresh interruption. Crude rose Friday even so, with traders weighing continuing disruption to Middle Eastern shipments against the prospect of United States-Iran diplomacy.

sources.title: Global Oil Market Set to Return to Surplus as Gulf Exports Recover, IEA Says

business.title: Mad Mex Becomes Mad Mex Sol in Shadyside
business.latest_developments: Pittsburgh Magazine and the Post-Gazette reported Friday, November 13, that big Burrito Restaurant Group has reopened its original Shadyside Mad Mex as Mad Mex Sol after months of overnight renovations.
business.summary: The Shadyside location is the flagship of big Burrito's Cal-Mex chain and the company's first concept, and the overhaul reaches the interior, the exterior, and the menu. The rename signals how big Burrito plans to refresh a brand it has run in Pittsburgh for decades.

business.title: Tully Tube's Paper Pill Bottle Makes Time's List
business.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported Friday, November 13, that Tully Tube, a Point Breeze startup that makes pill bottles out of paper, has landed on Time's best innovations list.
business.summary: The company replaces the orange plastic prescription vial, which recyclers generally will not take, with a paper container. The recognition gives a small Pittsburgh manufacturer national visibility in a market defined by pharmacy chains and packaging incumbents.

sources.title: 'It's a no-brainer': Point Breeze startup making paper pill bottles clinches Time 'best innovations' nod

business.title: Goulash House Opens in Carnegie
business.latest_developments: TribLive reported Friday, November 13, that Andrea Golyha, who grew up in Hungary, has opened Goulash House in Carnegie.
business.summary: The restaurant serves the traditional Hungarian comfort food Golyha ate at Sunday dinners at home, in a borough whose commercial district has drawn a run of independent food businesses.

around_town.title: The First Flakes Arrive With Slick Spots
around_town.latest_developments: WTAE and KDKA put the season's first flurries over Western Pennsylvania Friday, November 13, mixing into a chilly rain, with showers changing to snow showers Friday into Saturday and slick spots on the roads.
around_town.summary: Most of what falls will be cold rain, and the flurries come and go through the day as temperatures drop behind the front. TribLive found the forecast already filling shops such as Flynn's Tire in Hempfield, where manager Neal Morgan expects a rush the moment the words "possible snow flurries" appear.

around_town.title: Buffalo Township Writes a Data Center Ordinance
around_town.latest_developments: TribLive reported Friday, November 13, that Buffalo Township will hold a public hearing next month on a data center ordinance drafted so that neighbors would not "hear, smell or see" any such building.
around_town.summary: The township is taking the regulate-first route while other municipalities around Pittsburgh move to block or pause data centers outright. The ordinance sets the noise, odor, and sight-line limits a developer would have to meet before putting computing capacity in the township.

sources.title: Buffalo Township to host public hearing next month for data center ordinance

around_town.latest_developments: WPXI reported late Thursday, November 12, that the Highlands School District has canceled Friday classes because of a planned power outage.
around_town.summary: Students across the district stay home Friday, November 13, while utility work cuts power to school buildings.

events.summary: The tour sends visitors through private houses dressed for the holidays, and the proceeds support the Pittsburgh Symphony Orchestra. NEXTpittsburgh counts it among six winter house tours running across the greater Pittsburgh region this season.

events.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported Friday, November 13, on Encore Players, a new McCandless theater group that casts only performers aged 55 and up.
events.summary: The company gives older actors in the North Hills a stage of their own, and its organizers summed up the premise this way: "Creativity doesn't have an expiration date."

around_teams.title: The Steelers Call the Passing Game a Work in Progress
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported Friday, November 13, that Aaron Rodgers and Mike McCarthy describe the Steelers passing game as a "work in progress" and laid out how they intend to fix it, two days before the game at Cincinnati.
around_teams.summary: Rodgers met the media Wednesday, November 11, in his first session after the bye and the trade deadline, and the Steelers posted the full press conference. The passing offense remains the soft spot on a team riding its defense into a Sunday night meeting with the Bengals for the AFC North lead.

around_teams.title: Heyward, Metcalf, and the Week 10 Numbers
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers posted Thursday's press conference, November 12, with Cameron Heyward, Jamel Dean, DK Metcalf, Brock Hoffman, and Germie Bernard, and SNR Drive spent the same afternoon on the Week 10 stats packet.
around_teams.summary: Hosts Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler worked through Bill Barnwell's midseason awards and the numbers heading into Cincinnati, and took a call from Mike DeFabo of The Athletic. The team also released the full mic'd-up audio of outside linebacker Alex Highsmith from the Week 8 game against the Cleveland Browns, and is promoting Sunday's kickoff at 8:20 p.m. Eastern on NBC.

team_usa.title: Rapinoe, Altidore, and Ertz Enter the Hall of Fame
team_usa.latest_developments: The National Soccer Hall of Fame elected Megan Rapinoe, Jozy Altidore, and Julie Ertz on Thursday, November 12, all on the first ballot, and David Beckham also won election.
team_usa.summary: Rapinoe and Ertz anchored the United States women's national teams that won the 2015 and 2019 World Cups, and Altidore scored 42 goals for the men's national team across more than a decade. The class puts three recently retired American internationals into the hall in a single vote.

team_usa.title: Pochettino Agrees to Manage Manchester United
team_usa.latest_developments: Sources told ESPN early Friday, November 13, that Mauricio Pochettino has agreed to become Manchester United's manager, with an announcement expected the same day, and that the club may pursue two of his United States internationals.
team_usa.summary: Pochettino leaves the United States men's national team head coaching job to replace Michael Carrick, whom Manchester United sacked Thursday, November 12, with the club in the relegation zone. ESPN's transfer reporting has United looking at striker Folarin Balogun, who has said he expects to leave AS Monaco in January, and defender Alex Freeman.
